name: Innkeeper Grosk
summary: Innkeeper Grosk manages the inn at Razor Hill, providing weary travelers with food, drink, and a place to rest in central Durotar. Located on the bustling road between the Valley of Trials and Orgrimmar, his establishment serves as the primary resting point for young Horde adventurers setting out into the wider world.

sections.title: Hospitality in the Red Wastes
sections.body: Razor Hill serves as the vital crossroad settlement connecting the southern training grounds of Durotar to the high walls of Orgrimmar. At the center of this waystation stands Innkeeper Grosk, an orc tasked with sheltering warriors, scouts, and peons alike. His inn offers a respite from the harsh desert heat, stocked with basic provisions, hearty meats, and cool water for any traveler passing beneath its sturdy timbers.

sections.title: A Peon's Respite
sections.body: Beyond serving passing travelers, Grosk assists the local labor force that keeps Durotar running. In the quest 'A Peon's Burden', the timid peon Ukor, who hauled food all the way to the Valley of Trials only to find it was not needed, asks travelers to carry the load back to Grosk's inn in Razor Hill.

faq.answer: Innkeeper Grosk stands inside the inn at Razor Hill, situated right in the center of Durotar along the primary road leading north toward Orgrimmar.

faq.q: What services does Innkeeper Grosk provide?
aliases: can i bind hearthstone at razor hill
faq.answer: Grosk acts as an innkeeper where Horde adventurers can bind their Hearthstone to Razor Hill. He also sells basic food, water, and meat to replenish health and mana between travels.

faq.q: Does Innkeeper Grosk offer any quests?
faq.answer: He is involved in the quest 'A Peon's Burden', receiving the load of food that the peon Ukor was too frightened of Durotar's beasts to carry back to Razor Hill himself.

angles.text: For newly blooded orcs, trolls, and visiting tauren traveling north from the Valley of Trials or Sen'jin Village, Grosk's inn marks the first true town and hearth location on the road toward Orgrimmar.
